input.description: Signs on to Meridian Core as a teller operator, searches for a member by member number, selects the member record, and reads the SHARES / BALANCES table (share id, type, balance, status for each share).

inputs.name: member_number
inputs.description: The member number to look up (e.g. 100234)

outputs.name: shares_balances
outputs.description: Tab-delimited text of the SHARES / BALANCES table: Share ID, Type, Balance, Status for every share on the member record
